# Rafiq v0.5.18: a terminal that speaks Arabic

## New
- **The terminal on its own.** Install `rafiq` without the app, for the current user, no administrator rights:
  - Windows: `irm https://rafiqagent.com/install.ps1 | iex`
  - macOS (Apple Silicon): `curl -fsSL https://rafiqagent.com/install.sh | sh`

  The script checks the download against its published SHA-256 and puts `rafiq` on your PATH; run it again to update. The first run helps you add a model (your own key, or a free local one with Ollama).
- **Ask mode asks before every step**, reads included, and an edit shows as a diff before you allow it. «Always allow this kind» stops asking for that tool for the rest of the session.
- **More of what a coding terminal does:**
  - `rafiq -p "…"` prints one reply and leaves; pipe text in (`type log.txt | rafiq -p "what's wrong?"`), `--yes` allows steps that need permission, `--output-format json`.
  - `rafiq -c` continues the last chat in this folder, `rafiq -r` picks one, `rafiq "…"` starts with a message.
  - `/review`, `/commit`, `/context`, `/export`, `/copy`, `/task`, `/permissions`, `/doctor`, `/think`, `/vim`, `/release-notes`, `/bug`.
  - Your own commands: `.md` files in `.rafiq/commands` (in the project, or in Rafiq's data folder); `$ARGUMENTS` becomes what you type after the command.
- **Add a model from the terminal** with `/model add` (or the last entry in `/model`): pick the provider, paste the key (never shown or kept in history), pick from the models it offers; Rafiq tests it before adding it.
- **A cleaner terminal:** the input sits between two lines with the mode and model under it; the `/` menu lists every command with what it does; replies start with ●, tool steps show their result in three dim lines; `/status`, `/cost`, `/help` and the lists open a screen of their own (Esc goes back); Esc stops a reply, and what you type meanwhile waits in the next prompt.

## Fixed
- In ask mode, steps that only read (finding and listing files) ran without asking.
- In Arabic, the line shown while Rafiq starts its agent came out reversed.

## Updating
Rafiq offers the update by itself. Or download `Rafiq_0.5.18_x64-setup.exe` below and check it:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.18_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the result with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

macOS (Apple Silicon): [Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/download/macos/Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg). The terminal on its own: the [cli](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/tag/cli) release.
